title: Smoke 10 - Patient View Basic
description: Minimal CDS service that always emits one info card.
cqlContent:
library "Smoke10PatientView" version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

context Patient

define "HelloCard":
  Tuple {
    summary: 'Smoke 10 card fired',
    detail: 'This card proves the CDS hook pipeline works end-to-end.',
    indicator: 'info',
    sourceLabel: 'Smoke Harness'
  }
